name: Carbonation and frost resistance of CEM I and CEM III/B concretes (w/c 0.40, 0.50, 0.60, with and without air entrainment; standard curing, calcium nitrate solution, demineralized water; carbonated and uncarbonated): stitched BSE-SEM montages at a fixed 84.31 nm/px with the raw MAPS 3.5 tile project, raw LTDSC heat flow (thermoporometry, ice mass), compressive strength, CF/CIF liquid uptake, scaling and ultrasonic RDME. Data: refodat doi:10.71758/refodat.91 (Unbehau, Kleiner, Kind, Mueller, Dehn, Ludwig 2026, DFG 505859222). Descriptor: not linked in DataCite
state: prospective, filled 2026-10-06 (track other_) from DataCite https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.71758/refodat.91; nothing downloaded or measured. BSE covers only four CEM III/B specimens (w/c 0.40 and 0.60, carbonated and uncarbonated, IDs 21C, 21H, 25C, 25H); LTDSC runs on hardened paste, so the BSE-to-LTDSC specimen join needs a check.

readers.notes: 15 files, 1038.68 MB: .xlsx and .csv (pandas, openpyxl), .zip and .7z (py7zr), .svg, stitched .tif (tifffile); RAW_Maps_project_21H-25H-21C-25C.7z holds unstitched Thermo Fisher MAPS 3.5 tiles (tile TIFF tags readable with tifffile; the MAPS project file itself needs a check)

calibration.notes: BSE: Helios G4 UX, 10 kV, 0.1 nA, BSE detector, 84.31 nm/px for all four montages (about 1209 to 1259 x 323 um each). LTDSC delivered as raw heat flow with baseline corrections (cycles A and B). Strength per DIN EN 12390-3; frost per DIN TR 15177 and DIN CEN/TS 12390-9 with raw mass and ultrasonic transit data
